findings.body: The latest worker handoff contains a mapping headed `Current proof list for LIVE detail 7:`, but Forge requires the exact heading `Proof list:`. The extraction at src/forge/review.py:220 and 400–408 therefore returns nothing, and src/forge/close.py:434 cannot copy the mapping into the PR. This explains why the supplied proof list remains `missing`. Rename the handoff heading so the complete mapping reaches both review and PR.

findings.body: The previous advisory remains open: this replacement has no retry when Windows refuses to replace a file held open by a reader. Both views read events.jsonl without the writer guard at src/forge/board.py:203–204, so an overlapping refresh can raise PermissionError and abort the enclosing worker, reader, review or test command. Add bounded retries, following the existing replacement handling at src/forge/codex.py:532–539.
findings.title: Handle Windows readers holding the progress file open

findings.body: The previous advisory remains open. Claude can report a missing resumed session in a structured stdout result ([upstream reproduction](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/40609)). This decoder places `error_during_execution` before the diagnostic, so the worker's `No conversation found` prefix check at src/forge/worker.py:443–445 misses it. The reader checks only stderr at src/forge/story.py:738–740, although the decoded error is returned on stdout. Both paths consequently refuse instead of recovering with a fresh session. Preserve and recognize the structured missing-session diagnostic in both callers.
findings.title: Preserve missing-session recovery for structured Claude errors
